body:
## Problem

v0.77.0 has two different administrator credential models:

- startup can mint an admin-scoped `la_sk_` HS256 JWT;
- the web first-visitor claim and `/api/admin/rotate` return `la_admin_...` opaque values with no JWT segments.

A live two-phase browser claim confirms this (`la_admin_` has one dot-separated part; an issued AI token has three). The opaque credential is stored as a digest in `admin-claim.json` and does not carry the JWT `sub`/`iat`/`exp`/`scope` claims requested in #49. Telegram/VK share this parallel claim credential.

This leaves the primary browser/chat administrator outside the token model that was introduced specifically to provide identity, expiry, scope, revocation, and rotation. It also makes `TOKEN_ADMIN_KEY`, startup admin JWT, and first-visitor admin credentials behave differently.

## Expected behavior

- A confirmed first visitor in web, Telegram, or VK receives an admin-scoped `la_sk_` JWT with `sub`, `iat`, `exp`, label and `scope=admin` (or an explicitly documented equivalent JWT claim).
- The administrator can choose/limit TTL; expiry is enforced uniformly.
- Rotation atomically mints a new admin JWT and revokes the old JWT by id.
- The UI stores the JWT in localStorage only after read-back, preserving the existing two-phase anti-bricking handshake.
- The single global first-claim lock remains shared by web, Telegram and VK.
- `TOKEN_ADMIN_KEY` remains an optional bootstrap/compatibility credential, and an externally supplied admin JWT can be provided through environment/secret file without creating a second credential model.
- Admin-token list/show/revoke/audit behavior uses the same persistent token manager and never exposes token values after issuance.
- Migration preserves existing `la_admin_` claims long enough for an operator to rotate them into JWTs, with a clear doctor warning.

Add end-to-end tests for web claim, chat claim, cross-channel claim exclusion, expiry, restart persistence, and atomic rotation.
title: Use the scoped JWT model for first-visitor web/chat admin credentials
